mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy shift that reduces equity discount rates and boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and depress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with both RSAFS and HOUST declining, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (GDPC1 growth < 0), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO decline and GDPC1 growth < 0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates reduced residential construction activity, which correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with declining HOUST, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls exceeding 100,000 (PAYEMS change < -100) signals significant job losses, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS change < -100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), a monthly decline in CPIAUCSL signals easing inflation pressures, which reduces uncertainty and boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and CPIAUCSL decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) signal a broad-based economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with both INDPRO and GDPC1 declining, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
